items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting more than one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information has been exposed, making this highly relevant to schools and training organisations across the country. If your organisation uses Mathspace, assume your details may be compromised and watch for phishing emails or suspicious contact using your personal information.

Separately, a phone-based attack technique is being used to trick employees into handing over access to Microsoft 365 accounts — particularly on personal devices used for work. Be cautious of unexpected calls asking you to verify your work login details.

**Tip:** Never confirm or share your work account credentials over the phone, no matter how convincing the caller sounds.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
